tools.name: get_operations_overview
tools.title: Get operations overview
tools.description: Get the executive dashboard snapshot: platform health, cost savings, active incidents, security alerts, plus health/cost trend, cost by cloud, and incidents by service.

tools.name: list_change_records
tools.title: List change records
tools.description: List change records from the Aegis Change Control Center, with optional filtering by lifecycle stage, risk tier, execution mode, or owning team.

risk.description: Risk tier: Low, Medium, High, or Critical.

executionMode.description: Execution mode: Manual, Assisted, or Automatic.

tools.name: get_change_record
tools.title: Get change record
tools.description: Get the full change record for a Change ID, including AI reasoning, risk factors, approvals, rollback plan, validations, timeline, audit hashes, and external tickets.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List AI agents
tools.description: List the Aegis AI operations agents with status, domain, action counts, and (optionally) their recent findings.

includeFindings.description: Include each agent's recent findings. Defaults to false.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.title: List integrations
tools.description: List the Aegis platform integrations (Genesys, AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365, Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Slack, GitHub, ...) with connection status, auth type, and last sync.

status.description: Filter by status: connected, available, or action_required.

tools.name: list_incidents_and_alerts
tools.title: List incidents and security alerts
tools.description: List open operational incidents and security alerts, optionally filtered by severity (critical, high, medium, low, info).

tools.name: list_reports_and_recommendations
tools.title: List reports and AI recommendations
tools.description: List available executive reports (with their dataset rows) and the pending AI recommendations that feed the Change Control Center.

reportId.description: Return only this report's rows, e.g. license-utilization.
